latest.title: I built the brain of Zyvarin Social. Redis handles the chaos.
latest.description:
Built Zyvarin Social to stop rewriting the same content for every platform. One source becomes optimized posts for LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Dev.to, and Pinterest using Gemini AI. Added Redis for caching, rate limiting, locks, and faster responses. Built scheduling with Node Cron jobs for platform-specific publishing and retries. Reduced failed posts from 15% to under 1% and cut API costs by 40% through caching and smarter backend architecture.

latest.title: CodePulse - Security Engine
latest.description: I built the Security Engine for CodePulse, which scans uploaded Python code for vulnerabilities using Bandit, Semgrep, and a custom AST fallback scanner. I also fixed a critical Windows compatibility bug and built the SQL injection detection module, with all findings feeding directly into the interactive forensic risk map.

latest.title: CodePulse – AST Core & Risk Analysis Development
latest.description: As the Team Lead and Core Backend Developer of CodePulse, I built the AST-based analysis engine, dependency graph system, and risk scoring modules that formed the core intelligence of the platform. I also developed innovative features like taint-flow analysis and blast-radius scoring to track vulnerability propagation and assess security impact across the codebase.

latest.title: Bazaar ai
latest.description: BaazarAI is an AI-powered digital storefront generator that puts small-town kirana shops on the internet — vendors scan their shelves, AI detects products, prices are fetched automatically, and a live store goes up at their own URL with zero manual entry. My contribution was building the three storefront templates (Grid, List, and Dark) that buyers actually land on, along with the Admin Panel where vendors review and publish their shop, and the landing page that introduces the whole platform.

latest.title: CodePulse-Frontend+Graph
latest.description:
Built the frontend using a split-pane layout in App.jsx, featuring interactive react-cytoscapejs graph visualizations with force-directed layouts and bidirectional node-to-code syncing.
Implemented severity-based color coding, vulnerability propagation tracing, and a stats-driven ReportPanel while resolving JSX template literal bugs to ensure stable production builds.

latest.title: BaazarAI: AI-Powered Digital Storefronts for Kirana Shops

latest.title: BazaarAI. My contribution
latest.description: BaazarAI is a mobile application designed to instantly digitize local kirana shops using real-time computer vision. By simply pointing a smartphone camera at store shelves, the app automatically identifies and catalogues products, eliminating the need for manual data entry. Powered by React Native, Supabase, and Groq's lightning-fast Language Processing Unit running LLaVA 1.5 7B, BaazarAI generates a fully functional, shareable e-commerce storefront for vendors in minutes.

latest.title: CodePulse - LLM + DevOps
latest.description:
I engineered a robust, local AI infrastructure featuring asynchronous SSE streaming via `qwen2.5-coder`, centralized `.env` configuration, and hardened security through path traversal protection.
I further ensured project readiness by architecting the full dependency environment, cross-platform Ollama deployment guides, and a comprehensive multi-vulnerability suite for live demonstration.
